customManagers.description: The Node pin is the runtime the generator and the deploy CLI run on, and it lives in the `setup-node` composite action, so Renovate reads it out of that YAML.

packageRules.description: Direct dependencies are exact pins (`bunfig.toml` makes `bun add` write them too); Renovate replaces any range it finds with the resolved exact version, so the policy cannot drift. Sourcey is the generator the page is rendered by, so a bump is a page that changes: it lands as its own PR.
Bun is the package manager: its pin is the one line of package.json "packageManager" that setup-bun reads in CI, so every bump lands in a single PR.
The Node pin governs the runtime the generator and `cf` run on (`.github/actions/setup-node`), so it moves on its own release line.
